overview_description.description:
CarSwitch is a UAE-based online marketplace and car-buying platform that helps people buy and sell used cars directly from private owners with added inspection and transaction support. The platform was launched in 2016 and focuses on making used-car transactions more transparent, safe, and convenient.
The platform connects buyers with verified sellers and provides services such as vehicle inspection, price valuation, financing assistance, warranty options, and secure payment processing. Each listed vehicle typically undergoes a comprehensive inspection (around 200 points), and the results are shared online so buyers can check the car’s condition before arranging a test drive.

product.name: Used Car Buying Platform
product.description: An online platform that facilitates the purchase of used cars in the UAE by providing listings, certified inspections, and secure payment options.

product.name: Used Car Selling Service
product.description: A service that assists car owners in selling their used vehicles by managing listings, inquiries, test drives, and ownership transfer processes.

product.name: Car Inspection and Certification
product.description: A comprehensive vehicle inspection service that evaluates used cars on a 200-point checklist and provides certification and warranty to buyers.

product.name: Online Car Financing Guidance
product.description: An informational service providing guidance on car financing options in the UAE, including conventional loans, Islamic financing, and green auto financing for electric vehicles.

product.name: Used Electric Vehicle Marketplace
product.description: A specialized section of the platform dedicated to buying and selling pre-owned electric vehicles with certified inspections and warranty.
